true_answer: Meanwhile, an observer from the outside will see the subject move closer to the black hole until the extreme, in which the subject appears 'frozen' in time and eventually fade to nothingness due to the diminishing amount of light returning.[100][101] e animations visualise the diﬀerent treatments of time in the Newtonian and the relativistic descriptions. At the heart of these diﬀerences are the Galilean and Lorentz transformations applicable in the Newtonian and relativistic theories, respectively. In the ﬁgures, the vertical direction indicates time.
